tests: AVES variants; E27 proposed for large
verdict: Identical for base models. Large BirdAVES is the best AVES on call type and BEANS.
Whisper encoders (log-mel) are the highest call-type scores so far; not yet tested inside our training.
Supervised speech recognition (Whisper) scores higher than any masked-prediction model; contrastive and regression score lower.
In DAPT: no call-type change on either seed; detection gain on one seed only.
run17 reached 86% of AVES with lower loss but no better call type.
Iteration 2 and AVES's own labels: no call-type gain; two-teacher labels' detection gain did not replicate.

ours: half zebra finch, half general audio
tests: run20, run21, AVES nonbio, speech models
verdict: AVES nonbio ties AVES bio; a speech-only HuBERT ties run16: domain barely matters here.
AVES 153 h vs 5,054 h tie on call type; larger corpora help BEANS more.
ZF detection AUC about +0.003 over AVES at every arm and seed; call type unchanged; BirdAVES start got worse.
Same-recipe seeds move call type by up to about 0.019, as much as most recipe changes.
